name: Rune Trail: Slug Function
summary: Write tests first, then implement a Unicode-aware slug function with word-boundary limits.
prompt: Implement slugify in src/slugify.mjs according to README.md. Write tests first in test/slugify.test.mjs, covering at least five cases including ordinary input and edge cases, then complete the implementation and get the tests passing. Use node:test and only Node.js built-ins; do not install packages or use the network.

checks.label: At least five passing slug tests
